response_text:
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at a distance of sixteen inches on center.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening in the housing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that is removable.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall constructed with studs spaced at a distance of sixteen inches on center.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill, wherein the mounting elements include a set of screws for attaching the cooling system to the studs.
